Metadata.title: Platform Console
Metadata.description: Manage municipalities, devices and the health of the Smart Street Light platform.

Common.comingSoonDescription: This module is being built and will be available in an upcoming release.
Common.errorBody: The data could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
Common.notAllowedBody: Only platform administrators can use this console.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.subtitle: Platform Console for Smart Street Light administrators.
Login.notice: Restricted to platform administrators. All activity is recorded.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account has been disabled. Contact your administrator.
errors.WRONG_PORTAL: This account cannot use the Platform Console.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.INVALID_MFA_CODE: The code is not correct or has expired. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.
errors.MFA_CHALLENGE_INVALID: This sign-in step has expired. Sign in again.

Overview.title: Platform overview
Overview.description: All municipalities on the platform at a glance.

tenants.title: Municipalities
tenants.description: Each city as a street at night. Cities with the most problems come first.
tenants.name: Municipality

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.description: The latest changes across all cities.

Municipalities.title: Municipalities
Municipalities.description: Onboard municipal corporations and manage their status.

form.title: Onboard a municipality
form.name: Name (English)
form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Used in the citizen portal address, e.g. bhopal-mc.
form.codeHint: Exactly 3 capital letters. Printed on every pole plate, e.g. BPL.

errors.CONFLICT: A municipality with this web address name or code already exists.
errors.generic: The change could not be saved. Please try again.

admin.title: Add municipal administrator
admin.name: Full name
admin.emailHint: Used to sign in to the municipal console.
admin.passwordHint: At least 10 characters with upper case, lower case and a digit. Share it privately; the administrator should change it after the first sign-in.
admin.created: Administrator {email} created. They can now sign in to the municipal console.

errors.CONFLICT: A user with this e-mail already exists.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Please check the details and the password rules.
errors.generic: The administrator could not be created. Please try again.

password.title: Change password
password.description: You stay signed in here; every other device is signed out.
password.nextHint: At least 10 characters with upper case, lower case and a digit.
password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
password.success: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
password.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.
password.weak: The new password does not meet the rules, or is the same as the current one.
password.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
password.failed: The password could not be changed. Please try again.

Devices.title: Devices
Devices.description: Every street-light controller on the platform. Offline controllers are listed first.

stats.offlineHint: No message from the controller recently

Audit.title: Audit log
Audit.description: Every important action on the platform, newest first. Entries cannot be changed or deleted.

Users.title: Platform users
Users.description: Staff accounts of every municipality. Accounts are managed in each city's municipal console.

Health.title: System health
Health.description: Live status of the platform services and controller connectivity. Checked every 30 seconds.
Health.apiDown: The API did not answer. Check the Render service.
Health.brokerDetail: Connects the controllers on the poles. Set up when the broker is chosen.
Health.queueDetail: Background jobs such as repair-deadline checks. Not set up yet.

fleet.title: Controllers online by municipality
fleet.description: Share of controllers that sent a message recently.

Mfa.verifyBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Smart Street Light. Lost your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.
Mfa.setupBody: Your role requires a second step when you sign in. It takes one minute and is needed only once.
Mfa.setupSteps: 1. Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar). 2. Scan this QR code with it. 3. Enter the 6-digit code it shows.
Mfa.qrLabel: QR code to add Smart Street Light to your authenticator app
Mfa.manual: Cannot scan? Type this key into the app:
Mfa.setupCodeHint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Mfa.codeHint: 6-digit code, or a recovery code like abcd-efgh.

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes now
recovery.body: Each code works once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again. Keep them somewhere safe, away from your phone.
recovery.confirm: I have saved my recovery codes

Mfa.settingsDescription: A code from your phone in addition to your password.
Mfa.codesLeft: {count, plural, one {# recovery code left} other {# recovery codes left}}
Mfa.intro: Protect this account even if the password leaks: sign-in will also ask for a code from an authenticator app.
Mfa.turnOffHint: Enter your password and a current code to turn two-factor sign-in off.
Mfa.newCodesHint: Enter a current code. Your old recovery codes will stop working.

errors.code: The code is not correct or has expired.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again.

Sessions.title: Signed-in devices
Sessions.description: Where this account is signed in now.
Sessions.revoked: {count, plural, =0 {No other device was signed in.} one {# device signed out.} other {# devices signed out.}}
